import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long INF = (long) 1e15;
    static final int MAX_LIMIT = 1000010;
    static List<Long> patternNumbers = new ArrayList<>();
    static int minMoves = MAX_LIMIT;

    public static void search(long x, int steps) {
        if (steps > minMoves)
            return;
        if (x == 0) {
            minMoves = steps;
            return;
        }
        int lowerIdx = Collections.binarySearch(patternNumbers, x);
        if (lowerIdx < 0) {
            lowerIdx = -lowerIdx - 1;
        }
        int upperIdx = lowerIdx;
        if (upperIdx >= patternNumbers.size()) {
            upperIdx = patternNumbers.size() - 1;
        }
        if (lowerIdx == upperIdx) {
            lowerIdx = lowerIdx - 1;
            if (lowerIdx < 0) {
                lowerIdx = 0;
            }
        }
        long lowerVal = patternNumbers.get(lowerIdx);
        long upperVal = patternNumbers.get(upperIdx);
        long diffA = x - lowerVal;
        int cost = lowerIdx;
        long diffB = upperVal - x;
        search(x % lowerVal, steps + cost * (x / lowerVal));
        search(diffB, steps + cost + 1);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        patternNumbers.add(0L);
        for (int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i) {
            long last = patternNumbers.get(patternNumbers.size() - 1);
            patternNumbers.add(last * 10 + 1);
        }
        search(n, 0);
        System.out.println(minMoves);
        sc.close();
    }
}
